body.name: \(\operatorname{Enum}_G\)
body.construction: Precompute \(\beta(A,r)\) on live edges; separately for each original row label sort these finite exact-real rows lexicographically and intern equal rows as one integer identifier; set \(H_{\varnothing}=\{F_{\varnothing}\}\); process live subsets by cardinality and, for every \(F\in H_A\) and live edge \(A\to A\cup\{r\}\), write the interned identifier of \(\beta(A,r)\) into slot \(r\) and insert the resulting integer vector into a deterministic binary trie for \(H_{A\cup\{r\}}\) only if absent; emit every decoded member of \(H_V\) once.
